text.content: 2026-08-17 - R3 structurally conditioned visual memory terminal result

Experiment CWAM-COSMOS3-B5-VOM-PROBE-R3-20260817 used commit 1fa9d1c2b14f544f5b8e4e9ff4a968197ab7e8a4 and 8 B200 GPUs. It completed 500 finite steps and a complete iter_000000500. Temporal correspondence improved 0.8570142 to 0.0064946 and memory-only future-action loss improved 1.6276376 to 0.3089735, but slot absolute cosine worsened to 0.9996318. On the same 2048 examples, main action loss was none 0.0082432544, zero 0.0082443468, shuffle 0.0082437079, only 0.01325% and 0.00550% aligned gains. Decision: failed anti-collapse and causal-use gates; do not launch 20k. Preserve R2 competitive anti-collapse and next add object-local correspondence with negatives or action-gradient localization.
